summary.text: Shawn Sweeney is a Democratic state representative from Chittenden-7 who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a construction small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Shawn Sweeney earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Houston, and his career experience includes working as a construction small business owner.
Sweeney assumed office on January 8, 2025, succeeding Jessica Brumsted, and advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.
